sections.title: An open window into the site
paragraphs: Pulse makes the structure of Simpyll visible: what is published, how articles connect, and where automated technical checks find opportunities. Search and visitor metrics remain unavailable until separately authorized Google integrations.

sections.title: One audit, two outputs
paragraphs: The existing SEO validator reads prerendered HTML. Pulse projects a versioned, allowlisted public snapshot from that result; actionable findings stay in ignored local artifacts. Native SVG and HTML provide visualizations without a charting dependency.

Publication and explicit revision metadata describe currently published content. These are not traffic measurements or a complete historical inventory. Accessible tables accompany charts and graph exploration.
